# CYBOU

CYBOU is an experimental identity-centered platform for private communication
and user-controlled files. Mail and Files are required product surfaces with
Gmail-familiar and Google Drive-familiar workflows under CYBOU branding.

## Active protocol target

- Genesis-bound hybrid-PQ single-operator PoA finality; centralized trust, no
  Byzantine fault tolerance claim.
- Generic RootPublication is the only application-content operation.
- Application payloads use a streaming encrypted ROOT/INDEX/DATA tree.
- ChunkID is full BLAKE3-256 of stored encrypted bytes.
- Recipient identity, schemas, filenames, and graph structure stay encrypted.
- Providers accept chunks only with finalized-publication admission proofs.
- Clients scan publications, recover content keys, and rebuild local indexes.
- No legacy protocol compatibility or dual operation decoder is part of the
  target.

## Product requirements

- One account-level Identity with portable clean-machine recovery.
- Mail starts one-recipient and text-only. Attachments follow shared storage
  durability and recovery gates.
- Files uses private encrypted catalogs over the same chunk substrate.
- Backup is post-Beta.
- Finalized, available, and retrievable content are distinct user-facing states.

## Authority and status

- `AGENTS.md` is the implementation authority.
- `docs/cybou/POA_FINALITY.md`, `ENCRYPTED_CHUNK_TREE.md`,
  `ROOT_PUBLICATION.md`, `STORAGE_ADMISSION.md`, and
  `IDENTITY_DISCOVERY_AND_RECOVERY.md` define the protocol target.
- `spec/poa_chunk_tree.yaml` contains machine-readable parameters.
- `docs/cybou/26_IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md` records implementation and open
  integration gates. The target is not active on DEV; do not reset DEV before
  all coordinated gates pass.
